extracted.name: 3-cheese baked Ziti pasta
extracted.description: Take your pasta to the next level by adding cheese and baking it in the oven😋 this was a dish packed with flavor in every bite! Recipe originated from @onestopchop_ on Insta
instruction_lines: Heat a pot of water, add your pasta once it starts boiling and only boil for about 5-7 minutes. Drain and rinse with cold water. Set aside
Brown beef and turkey in a skillet. Add salt while browning then drain oil
Return meat to skillet, add chopped green pepper and remainder of seasonings. (Optional) add 1/2c water and cook until the water is absorbed
Pour 2 jars of pasta sauce. Lower the heat and simmer on medium low for about 10 minutes
Grease baking dish. Begin with meat sauce as the first layer, then after that mozzarella cheese, pasta, then ricotta. Repeat layers until your ingredients are gone.
Finish the top layer with meat sauce then Parmesan, and/or mozzarella
Cover with foil and bake for 15 min covered and 15 minutes uncovered.
